summary: Lead research for Blueprint MVP (architectural design/blueprint management platform). Targets architects, building departments, and residential designers in Ashtabula County and Northeast Ohio who could benefit from digital blueprint management, plan review tools, and design collaboration.

leads.fit_rationale: Provides plan review services, inspections, and code information. Digital blueprint submission and review tools would streamline permit processing and reduce paper handling.
Issues zoning permits and coordinates with County Building Department. Digital blueprint integration between city and county would improve workflow.
Local architect serving Ashtabula County. Digital blueprint management and client collaboration tools would enhance their design process.
Full-scope architectural services for residential, commercial, and historic renovation projects. Cloud-based blueprint management would support their multi-project workflow.
Specializes in new residential construction and renovations in Greater Cleveland/Akron area. Blueprint collaboration tools would improve client communication.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add digital blueprint upload with version control and revision tracking.
Include annotation tools for markups and collaborative feedback.
Create mobile-friendly viewing for field access to plans.
Integrate with building department permit submission workflows.
Add 3D visualization from 2D blueprints for client presentations.
Provide measurement and calculation tools within the blueprint viewer.
Include electronic approval signatures and stamp integration.
Add project sharing with controlled access for contractors and clients.

possible_issues: Blueprint tools need precision and clarity—cluttered UI interferes with technical work.
Slow rendering of large blueprint files frustrates architects and reviewers.
Poor mobile optimization makes field access difficult for contractors.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Blueprint management platforms can be white-labeled for building departments, architectural firms, or construction companies with custom branding.

action_next: Merge visual-analysis findings once the screenshot report exists.
Contact Ashtabula County Building Department about digital plan review pilot.
Reach out to local architects about blueprint collaboration tools.
Explore integration with common CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp).
